remarks: Welcome to 294 South Avenue located on one of New Canaan's premiere streets that leads into our scenic downtown, shopping, parks, schools, train station and restaurants. Great opportunity to renovate or start fresh. This brick style ranch home features 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms and room to expand into spacious attic area. The finished lower-level playroom, office and one car garage walks out to a lovely yard. All the amenities that in-town living has. This home is not to be missed! HOUSE AND PROPERTY BEING SOLD AS IS. Two and half bathrooms per field card. Lower level does have a full bathroom not half bathroom.
